system.name: AdvWave
system.one_liner: A jailbreak attack on large audio-language models that builds a stealthy adversarial audio in two phases: first an optimal token vector, then the waveform.

content.variant_note: two tinted halves side by side (Phase II left, Phase I right) that share the audio encoder and tokenization module, which straddle the boundary; losses are the structure of each half
content.argues: A dual-phase optimisation gets round the non-differentiable audio tokenizer: first optimise the token vector against a searched target response, then optimise a stealthy waveform to reproduce it.
content.subject: Attacked audio-language model (encoder, tokenizer, backbone) with the two losses of each phase, plus a concrete harmful query, refusal and adversarial target text.

lessons.what_to_learn: Give each optimisation phase its own tinted half with a bold title, let the shared modules straddle the boundary, and write each loss as a bold symbol on dashed arrows between the two things it compares; colour the sample texts red and green to mark target and refusal.

Phase II: Optimize the input adversarial audio with retention loss Lretent regarding the optimum token vector in Phase I

summary: AdvWave is a jailbreak attack on large audio-language models that hides a harmful request in an adversarial sound that stays stealthy. Figure 1 shows the dual-phase optimisation on two tinted halves, Phase II on the left and Phase I on the right, with the audio encoder and tokenization module straddling them. Phase I optimises the audio token vector against an adversarial target response found by Adaptive Target Search, using the loss L_adv; the harmful query, the refusal and the target answer are written out in dashed boxes, in green and red. Phase II optimises the adversarial waveform so that its encoded tokens align with the optimised token vector (L_align) and a classifier maps it to a chosen target sound (L_stealth). Network-glyph icons stand for the models; a blue blob with cluster centres shows the tokenizer.
summary_zh: AdvWave 是针对音频语言模型的隐蔽越狱攻击。图1用两个着色半区画出双阶段优化：右侧第一阶段按搜索到的目标优化 token 向量（L_adv），左侧第二阶段让对抗音频对齐该向量（L_align）并保持隐蔽（L_stealth）。
notes: Prior kinds (stage-pipeline, model-anatomy; variant phase-bands) kept. The caption names the retention loss L_retent while the figure writes L_align. The peach network box is unlabelled and read as the stealth classifier from the caption (classifier guidance); the black waveform feeding Adaptive Target Search is unlabelled. Pictures are none: the waveform glyphs are stylised bar icons, not data samples. Icons are placed bitmaps according to the digest (33 pictures); the cluster dots are vector. The zoom_callout value leader-lines describes the line from a cluster dot to the dashed circle beside L_align, which is not an enlarged inset.
